metadata.description: User-facing guide for Byzantine Royal × macOS Big Sur premium design system

overview.introduction: kindly-web uses a premium design system combining Byzantine Royal purple heritage with macOS Big Sur glassmorphism aesthetics. All visual effects are CSS-based (zero JavaScript runtime), enabling sub-16ms paint times and 60fps interactions.

philosophy.principle: Regal Minimalism: Byzantine purple (royalty) meets Apple restraint (simplicity)
Depth through Layers: 4-tier glassmorphism (8px → 32px blur) creates spatial hierarchy
Metallic Accents: Gold gradients as deliberate highlights (not decoration)
Performance First: CSS-only effects, no runtime calculations, GPU-accelerated

key-features.feature: Layered shadow system (dense/mid/soft purple + gold glow)
SF Pro Display typography (macOS native font stack)

palette.description: 10-tier royal purple gradient from deep midnight to soft lavender

palette.name: Metallic Gold Spectrum

accessibility.wcag-compliance: WCAG 2.1 Level AA (all color pairs ≥4.5:1 contrast)
accessibility.link-underlines: Underlined in high-contrast mode (keyboard navigation support)

glassmorphism.philosophy: macOS Big Sur introduced glassmorphism (frosted glass aesthetic) as a core design principle. kindly-web adapts this for web with 4-tier blur system and layered tints.

blur-level.name: Large Blur
blur-level.use-case: Navigation bars, hero sections, primary overlays

glassmorphism.example-glass-card: .glass-card { background: var(--glass-purple-mid); /* 40% purple tint */ backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-md)); /* 16px blur */ border: 1px solid var(--glass-border-bright); /* 30% gold */ border-radius: var(--radius-lg); /* 16px rounded */ box-shadow: 0 8px 32px var(--shadow-purple-soft); /* Soft purple shadow */ }

browser-support.fallback: Solid color background if backdrop-filter not supported

shadow-system.description: Layered shadow system creates depth hierarchy. Purple shadows establish spatial relationships, gold glows add highlights.

shadow.name: Soft Purple Shadow
shadow.use-case: Subtle elevation, hover states, gentle depth

shadow.name: Gold Glow
shadow.use-case: CTA buttons, interactive highlights, focus states

font-stack.primary: SF Pro Display, -apple-system, Inter, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif
font-stack.rationale: SF Pro Display is macOS native font (optimal rendering on Apple devices). Falls back to Inter (web-safe) and system fonts.

spacing-system.philosophy: 8px grid system ensures visual rhythm and alignment. All spacing multiples of 4px (0.25rem).

border-radius.macOS-influence: macOS Big Sur uses 12-16px radius for most UI elements. kindly-web follows this convention for premium consistency.

css-optimization.strategy: All effects CSS-only (zero JavaScript runtime calculations)
css-optimization.gpu-acceleration: backdrop-filter, transform, box-shadow use GPU (sub-16ms paint)
css-optimization.paint-budget: Target 16ms per frame (60fps), actual 8-12ms for complex glassmorphism
css-optimization.will-change: Use sparingly (only on hover/focus states to hint GPU layer promotion)

bundle-impact.font-loading: System fonts (zero network requests), SF Pro fallback to Inter (optional webfont)

from-old-css.step: 1. Replace hardcoded colors with CSS variables (--purple-*, --gold-*)
2. Add glassmorphism to surfaces (background: var(--glass-purple-mid) + backdrop-filter: blur(16px))
3. Replace box-shadow with layered shadow system (--shadow-purple-*, --shadow-gold-glow)
4. Update typography to SF Pro Display font stack
5. Audit spacing for 8px grid compliance (all margins/padding multiples of 4px)
6. Test accessibility (WCAG AA contrast, keyboard navigation)

fallbacks.no-backdrop-filter: Solid color background (var(--purple-900)) if backdrop-filter not supported
fallbacks.no-sf-pro: Falls back to Inter → system-ui (graceful degradation)
fallbacks.progressive-enhancement: Core experience works on all browsers, premium effects enhance on modern browsers

best-practices.guideline: Use glassmorphism sparingly (2-3 layers max to avoid visual clutter)
Gold accents are highlights, not decoration (1-2 per viewport)
Test dark/light mode variants (localStorage persistence required)
Validate WCAG AA contrast for all text (use browser DevTools)
Limit backdrop-filter to fixed/absolute elements (performance optimization)
Use will-change only on hover/focus (avoid permanent GPU layers)
Audit paint times in Chrome DevTools (target <16ms per frame)

anti-patterns.anti-pattern: Excessive blur levels (>32px causes performance issues)
Too many glass layers (3+ overlapping surfaces are visually confusing)
Gold everywhere (dilutes premium effect, use as deliberate accent)
Hardcoded colors (breaks theme switching, use CSS variables)
Inconsistent spacing (breaks 8px grid, harms visual rhythm)
